summary: Fixed CommandPalette so that after Tab completes a directory path, pressing Enter submits the completed path (with trailing separator stripped) rather than the currently highlighted child folder. Added a regression test, ran the full app test suite and `pnpm check` (both clean), and committed the change as `70495be`.
decisions: On Enter in workspace mode, submit the typed/resolved `location` (with trailing slash stripped) instead of the highlighted child, so Tab-completed paths round-trip correctly.

Place registry clones under `~/.gizmo/registries/<registry-name>/` rather than `~/.pi/agent/extensions-src/`, because Gizmo owns registry cloning/building/linking and `.gizmo` is the clearer boundary.
